summary: Austin Gold Corp. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, plus CEO and CFO certifications, and incorporated the exhibits by reference into its Form F-3 and Form S-8 registration statements. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural mechanic is disclosed. The balance sheet shows $257,564 cash, $1.01M short-term investments, a $13.7M deficit, and a going-concern note; the nine-month net loss was $1.99M. Watch liquidity and going-concern disclosure rather than deal terms.
